name: Ha Long seafood
summary: Hải sản at Bãi Cháy and Hạ Long is seafood cooked on the spot. A winter article says Quảng Ninh seafood is often stir-fried, boiled, or steamed, and also dried. No species list was printed.
origin: Bãi Cháy and the Hạ Long shore. Not a named shop.
howToEat: The page’s general line is xào, luộc, or hấp, and also dried.
The night article puts it on the Bãi Cháy evening streets. A lunch hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Bãi Cháy and the Hạ Long shore, cooked on the spot. Phố đi bộ Bãi Cháy, chợ đêm Hạ Long, and Sun Carnival Plaza are the night cluster on that article. An hour for that cluster was not printed.
priceBand: A stall price was not printed.
